name: SIMULACRA: Pipe Dreams
source:
Teddy’s life further falls apart as he starts to forget some pretty important things... He finds messages that he has no recollection of sending, and often finds himself blacking out with huge gaps of time missing. And it all started after he downloaded this mysterious free game called "FlapeeBird". It is up to you to help Teddy break free from the game's unnatural hold over him.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/878320/SIMULACRA_Pipe_Dreams/]Steam[/url]]
